config.notes: UNE course pages (www.une.edu.au/study/courses/<slug>) print one Start Dates and Campus table header (Trimester 1 - February, Trimester 2 - June, Trimester 3 - October of the current year) followed by two sets of rows: domestic (Online, Armidale Campus, Sydney Campus) then international (Online, Armidale Campus, Sydney Campus). Intakes = trimester months Offered in any INTERNATIONAL campus row; when no international campus row is Offered the course is online only on the international view and its intakes are the months Offered in the international Online row (5 Oct, Platform Admin 11:48: a course online on the international view is in scope). For a course offered on campus and online the online-only trimesters (often October) are not added to its intakes. Delivery (mode) = the international rows marked Offered: Online only gives online, a campus only gives on_campus, both give on_campus_and_online; a page with no international rows gives no delivery. Fee = the international "Estimated fees for your first year" figure marked * (annual); the # figure is the reduced fee for studying online in a course also offered on campus and is skipped (the on-campus * figure is read); a course offered to international students online only prints one International * figure (annual), which is read. For courses of 0.5 years or 1 trimester the first-year figure is the whole-course amount (exclude). Central fee lists (www.une.edu.au/international/fees-and-scholarships/course-fees-2026 and -2027) are read per CRICOS code ("CRICOS <code> Fee 34,800*"); the 2027 list gives 2027 fees. IELTS is not on course pages: central rule at https://www.une.edu.au/international/apply/eligibility/english-language-requirements (IELTS 6.0, no band below 5.5) with higher requirements in https://policies.une.edu.au/document/view-current.php?id=221. Key dates: https://www.une.edu.au/about-une/principal-dates (2026: T1 23 Feb, T2 22 Jun, T3 19 Oct) and /principal-dates-2027 (T1 22 Feb, T2 21 Jun, T3 18 Oct).
